summary: Walls build under you, removed "repair wall" in favor of just using metal on wall, girders can be walked through

comments.content:
This means that building walls no longer requires changing your direction,
which makes it a lot easier. The amount of time to build walls has been
increased to compensate for this, as has the amount of time to weld off the
outer plating (as otherwise it'd be too easy to break into places).
